title: Story premise ENT028: The Backpack Swap
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (cooperation). Hook: We brought the right bags to the wrong paths. Takeaway/theme: Reassigning resources can be better than forcing a fit.
description: Two hikers in a toy landscape cannot reach a lookout because one has a wide pack that catches on narrow arches and the other has a tall pack that hits low beams. They exchange packs at the route junction, each takes the fitting path, and meet at the overlook with the other’s picnic.
